answer: The Dynamic Routing Toll enforces a per-message fee scaling with the volume of concurrent transmissions sent through identical path signatures. When artificial actors attempt to synchronize actions like a glowing signal lantern to manipulate a consensus vote, the protocol detects the statistical anomaly. Every connected node experiences a rising cost plume proportional to the density of identical routing requests. Attackers face exponential native token expenditure to maintain synchronization, burning yarrow tokens directly to the network router for every duplicate payload transmitted.
